legend: The tumour is composed of long fascicles of spindle cells with elongated vesicular nuclei and palely eosinophilic cytoplasm, in a collagenous stroma. These tumours can have a bland appearance in many foci, mimicking other myofibroblastic neoplasms such as fibromatosis or nodular fasciitis.

At higher magnification, tumours frequently show features reminiscent of myofibroblasts, with elongated vesicular nuclei, frequent small nucleoli, and eosinophilic cytoplasm. Atypia is focal and mild, and there is scattered mitotic activity.
The tumour shows multifocal strong SMA expression, with frequent subplasmalemmal accentuation.
